items.name: escape
items.summary: Escapes all regular expression meta characters in `text`.

items.name: escape_into
items.summary: Escapes all meta characters in `text` and writes the result into `buf`.

items.name: is_escapeable_character
items.summary: Returns true if the given character can be escaped in a regex.

items.name: is_meta_character
items.summary: Returns true if the given character has significance in a regex.

items.name: is_word_byte
items.summary: Returns true if and only if the given character is an ASCII word character.

items.name: is_word_character
items.summary: Returns true if and only if the given character is a Unicode word character.

items.name: try_is_word_character
items.summary: Returns true if and only if the given character is a Unicode word character.
